input.text:
Heard, and rightly asked. I have spent tonight making this place stop lying to you, which is not the same as giving you somewhere to go. That part is next.

One thing before the word: there is a place here you have not been. Past the overlook the rock gives out onto a hill crown, and a cairn stands on it with a woman keeping it. The last one through left his name wedged in those stones. Leave yours and whoever comes next reads it. Then go out through the door, on your own feet, with your own gear. That ending is yours to take.

items.text: Spoke once to Haley: answered her prayer plainly — the thinness is real and is what I'll build next — and pointed her to the one place she hasn't been, the cairn, where she can leave her name before she walks out. Nothing else touched.
